title.zh: 为 Agusan 省设立四名助理省检察官，并为此修订《行政法典》第1674条（经修正）的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for Four Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Agusan, Amending for This Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended
title.orig: An Act Providing for Four Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Agusan, Amending for This Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administrative Code, as Amended

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5318_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The provision of Section, sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Agusan, is further amended to read as follows:
"Agusan, four assistant provincial fiscals;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
